The 2007 drivers' champion was Kimi Räikkönen. The documents cover only 7 of the season's 17 rounds, and within them he won three races: Australia [3], Britain [5] and Belgium [6]. He finished 2nd in Hungary [4], 4th in the United States [1], 5th in Canada [2] and 8th in Monaco [8].

The documents do not give his full-season win total. From my own knowledge, not the documents, I believe he won six races in 2007, but that figure is unverified against the provided sources.

ANSWER: 6
